blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) has begun constructing a Bailey bridge in Santa, Ilocos Sur, to provide temporary access to residents and motorists after the Calungbuyan Bridge was closed due to damage caused by continuous rains.
